rationale.text: A filter script hides the labelled native select and inserts its own widget, which holds a focusable text input (no type attribute) clipped out of sight, with no aria-labelledby, aria-label, title, associated label or label ancestor. The glossary lists the text input among form fields, and the test asks each field to meet one of its conditions; this one meets none. It is rendered (clipping does not remove it) and exposed. The custom check faults it (step 2), whatever the hidden native select gives; the finding is failed at both levels.
